integrity_statement: Analytical proof and reproducible independent numerical cross-checks are supplied; no independent mathematical audit is asserted.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns the compact intrinsic flat Möbius quotient, not smooth isometric embeddings into Euclidean three-space.
Only squared two-point intrinsic geodesic distances and their fixed-area average are classified; the full distribution is not addressed.
The standard glide-reflection image-distance construction is prior literature, and complete historical priority is not independently verified.
title: Exact geodesic dispersion and unique area-constrained optimum of flat Möbius bands
